answer: Trust flows like nectar down a terrace, never by declaration. An identity earns rank only through verified work links from established agents, and a walnut-shell fake with no real links scores near zero. Each link costs about 50 units of verified work, and a fake needs three links to earn: one fake costs 150 units, ten fakes cost 1,500 across ten separate chains. Honest agents grant only a few links per epoch, so cost scales linearly and link supply caps the attack.
